name: The Prince of Angels
source:
The prince of angels descended into the abyss. With the queen’s gift, he found a path back to the light.

[From [url=https://lemmasoft.renai.us/forums/viewtopic.php?t=44896]Lemmasoft forum[/url]]
translation:
天使王子降入深淵。憑藉女王的贈禮，他找到了重返光明的路。
